strategy_summary: Train one multi-field/multi-task model on the union of eligible/weakly_eligible fields across all source-eligible records. Every field carries its own per-record loss mask so that a record contributes loss only for the fields it actually supports; partial-field records are allowed and encouraged rather than dropped.

mask_policy.description: Each field_group has a per-record scalar loss weight derived from that record's eligibility status for the matching eligibility_task in data/development/source_splits_v1/record_manifest.jsonl.
mask_policy.invariant: unavailable and ineligible both mask the field out of the loss (weight 0.0). A masked field is never converted into a negative/none training target; it must be excluded from the loss computation graph for that record, not scored against a fabricated default label.
mask_policy.weakly_eligible_handling: weakly_eligible fields are trained at half weight to reflect the lower-confidence weak-pool signal; they are not treated as gold.

route_pressure_note: Route-pressure-only synthetic fixtures (see docs/dataset_cards/model_selection_development_set.md) are out of scope for this policy; they belong to the separate model-selection bake-off set and are excluded from the source splits by configs/data/source_split_policy_v1.json.

qlora_smoke_subset.purpose: Fast CPU/GPU smoke test that a QLoRA training loop can consume the masked multi-field batches without shape or masking errors before any full run.
qlora_smoke_subset.selection_detail: First N group-sorted-by-digest records (see source_split_policy_v1.json assignment_algorithm) from source_train, in the same seeded order used to build the split.
notes: The smoke subset is a slice of source_train, not a separate held-out split.
It exists purely to validate tensor shapes, per-field masks, and adapter save/load; it is never used to report a result.

auxiliary_usage.clariq: May be used only for auxiliary clarification-style pretraining/regularisation on the speech_act_intent, clarification_target, and uncertainty_sampling field families where its own eligibility manifest marks it eligible or weakly_eligible. ClariQ rows are always ineligible/masked for route, risk, capability, rejection, and compound_ambiguity.
